facts.subject: Chlorine Contact Basin
facts.text: The Chlorine Contact Basin and Clearwell Level Controller shall be tested under representative level, flow, and residual control conditions before treated water is released for routine distribution.

facts.subject: Clearwell Level Controller

facts.text: Storm Intake Mode shall be exercised in a planned drill that confirms operator prompts, intake constraints, and return-to-normal steps.

facts.subject: Chlorine Residual Alarm test
facts.text: A Chlorine Residual Alarm test shall verify annunciation, operator response guidance, acknowledgement behavior, and escalation to the appropriate duty staff.

facts.label: verify annunciation, operator response guidance, acknowledgement behavior, and escalation to the appropriate duty staff

facts.subject: Chief Operator
facts.text: The Chief Operator shall coordinate training so that operators understand the control concept, normal sequencing, manual fallback methods, and alarm response expectations.

facts.label: understand the control concept, normal sequencing, manual fallback methods, and alarm response expectations

facts.subject: Operator training
facts.text: Operator training shall include classroom review, simulator or dry-run practice where practical, field walkdowns, and supervised operation during early service.

facts.label: include classroom review, simulator or dry-run practice where practical, field walkdowns, and supervised operation during early service

facts.subject: Laboratory Technician
facts.text: The Laboratory Technician shall be trained on sample timing, result entry, data review responsibilities, and communication of unusual water quality findings.

facts.subject: Maintenance Planner
facts.text: The Maintenance Planner shall review commissioning defects, recurring nuisance alarms, calibration drift, and equipment access problems before preventive maintenance intervals are finalized.

facts.subject: Maintenance Planner
facts.text: The Maintenance Planner shall use the clip to compare observed pump condition with planned inspection intervals and corrective work priorities.

facts.label: compare observed pump condition with planned inspection intervals and corrective work priorities

facts.subject: Feedback from maintenance work orders
facts.text: Feedback from maintenance work orders shall be reviewed with operations so that control changes do not mask equipment degradation or create avoidable field effort.

facts.subject: Distribution readiness
facts.text: Distribution readiness shall be declared only after pressure control, reservoir or clearwell constraints, communications, and emergency contact paths have been verified.

facts.subject: Falcon
facts.text: Falcon shall confirm that distribution readiness messages are acknowledged before any planned change in pressure zone operating status.

facts.subject: South Distribution Pressure Station
facts.text: Before distribution readiness is declared, the South Distribution Pressure Station shall use the card to confirm zone status, valve lineup, and communication checks.

facts.subject: North Distribution Pressure Station
facts.text: The North Distribution Pressure Station shall be included in readiness checks for telemetry validity, pump permissives, local alarm indication, and operator communications.

facts.label: be included in readiness checks for telemetry validity, pump permissives, local alarm indication, and operator communications

facts.subject: Residuals Hauler
facts.text: During commissioning of residuals handling, the Residuals Hauler shall use the Backwash Solids Manifest to confirm load identity, destination, and acceptance requirements.

facts.label: confirm load identity, destination, and acceptance requirements

facts.subject: Chemical Supplier Driver
facts.text: The Chemical Supplier Driver shall follow site access, unloading, verification, and communication procedures established during commissioning and confirmed during training.

facts.label: follow site access, unloading, verification, and communication procedures

facts.subject: Records
facts.text: Records generated during commissioning and early operation shall be complete enough to support troubleshooting, regulatory review, warranty claims, and future operator training.

support troubleshooting, regulatory review, warranty claims, and future operator training

facts.subject: Records retention
facts.text: Records retention shall follow municipal policy and applicable drinking water requirements, with electronic records protected against unauthorized change and accidental loss.

facts.subject: Periodic performance reviews
facts.text: Periodic performance reviews shall compare actual plant operation with the control concept, including alarm burden, manual interventions, water quality stability, chemical use, and energy use.

facts.subject: Continuous improvement actions
facts.text: Continuous improvement actions shall be prioritized by risk, reviewed by the Chief Operator and Duty Engineer, tested before release, and incorporated into updated procedures and training materials.
